scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on their account and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Minh Nguyen and I'm 34. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Minh, I'm sorry to hear about this concern regarding an unrecognized charge. I would be happy to investigate this for you. To ensure I'm looking at the correct account and to protect your security, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with your profile?
Sure, my account number is 88293041 and my email is m.nguyen@email.com.

Thank you, Minh. I have successfully verified your account. I see the transaction for $76.00 dated two days ago from 'Global Tech Services'. Does that merchant name ring any bells, or would you like me to proceed with a formal transaction dispute?
No, that name doesn't sound familiar at all. I definitely didn't buy anything from them.

I understand. Under our 'Unauthorized Transaction Protection' policy, I have initiated a formal dispute for this charge. I have also placed a temporary block on your card to prevent any further unauthorized activity. You should receive a confirmation email with a case reference number shortly.
Okay, that's a relief. Will I get my money back soon?

Per our policy, a provisional credit for the $76.00 has been applied to your account while the investigation is ongoing. You will see this reflected in your balance within 24 hours. We aim to complete the final investigation within 10 business days.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's account, confirmed the unrecognized merchant, initiated a formal dispute, blocked the compromised card, and issued a provisional credit.

judge_scores.justification: The agent conducted appropriate security verification, maintained a warm and empathetic tone, and efficiently resolved the dispute by initiating a formal investigation, placing a card block, and applying a provisional credit. Furthermore, the agent correctly cited specific company policies and executed the resolution entirely within their own authority without unnecessary escalation.
